lines.en: One step covers three blocks.
Walking is slow, so now and then I blink.
My black hands hang below my knees.
No footfalls, and the grass does not stir.
I walk past and the blocks make way.
Legs too long; I walk like I am stepping fences.
Purple eyes glow in the dark.
Don't measure my height; you will step back.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方没有脚印。
lines.en: No footprints where I have been.
One blink lands me half a block off.
This forest cannot block my path.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候，空气发凉。
lines.en: The air chills as I walk through it.
Before you see me, the wind changes.

lines.zh: 两个我？刚才那个是残影。
lines.en: Two of me? That last one was an afterimage.

lines.zh: 我穿过树林，树梢才到我腰。
lines.en: I cross the woods; the treetops reach my waist.

lines.zh: 一步落下，地面陷了半格。
lines.en: Each step sinks half a block.
I stand still and the ender hums in my ears.

lines.zh: 这只手，能搬走整块石头。
lines.en: This hand can carry off a whole boulder.

lines.zh: 想砍我的手？它自己会走。
lines.en: Want my hand? It walks off on its own.
I rarely breathe; it is only a habit.
In the quiet, I listen to the End.
This body is too big to crouch.
Purple light turns inside my palm.

lines.zh: 我在想要不要拆这棵树。
lines.en: I am deciding whether to take this tree apart.
I lean on a tree and it bends slightly.
The endersoul rattles inside my bones.

lines.zh: 我数方块的棱角，数到困。
lines.en: I count block edges until I grow drowsy.
Don't stand in my shadow; it is cold.
I bend down to see you, like an ant.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，盯过很多人。
lines.en: These eyes have stared down many.

lines.zh: 你看我一眼，我记一整年。
lines.en: One glance from you stays a whole year.
Don't hold my gaze too long; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛比我的小很多。
lines.en: Your eyes are much smaller than mine.
I lower my head only to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 被直视的时候，我会想动手。
lines.en: Being stared at makes my hands restless.
You carry a trace of the End on you.
Don't hide behind that tree; I see you.

lines.zh: 我要看清你的手有没有剑。
lines.en: I want to see whether your hand holds a blade.
It stings; I have marked where you stand.
That blow pushed me back two blocks.
My hand is still attached. Patience.
Your blade scraped; my hide is tough.
You went for the hand. Clever.
The ender stirs inside the wound.
One hit from you earns three from me.
This much pain happens daily in the End.
My blood is purple and it evaporates.
Don't stand where my hand swings.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，不够塞缝。
lines.en: That little thing will not fill one gap.
Hold something purple and I might pause.
Ender pearl? Put it on the ground.
Food means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 你举得太高了，我懒得弯。
lines.en: You hold it too high; I will not bend.
That chorus fruit is mildly interesting.
Don't trade bread for my life.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你口袋里的珍珠。
lines.en: I can smell the pearl in your pocket.
Keep your hand steady, or I leave.
Feed me? Grow two meters first.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的高度，只到我腰。
lines.en: You hit me at waist height.
Move; my legs do not wait.
Touch me and you get knocked back.
Don't crowd my feet; you will be stepped on.
One turn of mine sends you flying.
My body is light, but it hits heavy.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的膝盖。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my knee.

lines.zh: 我退一步，地板响了一声。
lines.en: I step back and the floor groans.
Don't block me in a narrow hall.

lines.zh: 刚才那个不是我，是残影。
lines.en: That was not me just now, only an echo.

lines.zh: 末影人不谈这个，我们搬方块。
lines.en: Endermen skip such things; we move blocks.

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，像两根黑柱。
lines.en: Standing together, we look like two black pillars.

lines.zh: 珍珠落地的声音，比情话好。
lines.en: A pearl hitting stone beats any sweet talk.

lines.zh: 两个高的凑一起，树都嫌矮。
lines.en: Two of us together make trees feel short.
Not so close; I fear I will step on you.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子生下来就很高。
lines.en: Our children come out already tall.
Stare too long and we start fighting.

lines.zh: 这一带够安静，可以待着。
lines.en: This area is quiet enough to stay.
Keep your hands still; I take things seriously.
The wind of the End scatters our words.

lines.zh: 这块石头太轻，我一只手。
lines.en: This stone is light, one hand is enough.
Lift it up and set it elsewhere.

lines.zh: 手指太大，捏不住小东西。
lines.en: My fingers are too big for small things.
I will take this tree, roots and all.
I pick things up not to keep them.

lines.zh: 放回原处，位置错了就重摆。
lines.en: Back it goes; a wrong spot must be fixed.
The block in my hand grows hot.
Don't grab; my grip is solid.
This one goes somewhere else.

lines.zh: 末影之魂让手能穿过石头。
lines.en: The endersoul lets my hand pass through stone.
You have been seen; running changes nothing.
I reach out once and I have you.
Once locked, I follow to the end.
Don't think distance protects you.
The hand moves first, the body follows.
My shadow brushed against your boot.

lines.zh: 末地的规矩，看见就算数。
lines.en: In the End, seeing counts as a claim.

lines.zh: 我要的只是你别再站着。
lines.en: All I want is for you to stop standing there.
Your position is fixed in my mind.
Locked on you, and the air cools first.
Run; two strides and I am there.

lines.zh: 你的名字我不记，位置我记。
lines.en: I forget names; I remember positions.
You run ten blocks; I take one step.
Blinking behind you saves effort.
I do not tire, and neither does the ender.

lines.zh: 你在树间绕，我在树顶走。
lines.en: You weave between trees; I walk their tops.
I stay glued to your blind side.
Purple light is closing in on you.
Jump off the cliff and I jump too.

lines.zh: 这一带没有能挡住我的墙。
lines.en: No wall here can stop me.
Slow down and I am above your head.
I can hear you panting.
Chasing you, I do not need the path.
Three steps left and my hand comes up.
This palm can knock a door off.
I only need one hand to fight.
Wind howls when my hand comes down.
Your shield blocked once, then split.

lines.zh: 这一下，是末影之魂的意思。
lines.en: This blow is the endersoul's idea.
Don't stand close; my swing always lands.
I slam down and the ground dents.
My knuckles sweep in before you see them.
Does it hurt? I barely pressed.
Next swing, I will actually look down.

lines.zh: 紫色裂口张开，我跨出来。
lines.en: A purple tear opens and I step through.
The air cracks first, then comes me.
This forest is not tall enough for me.
The ender pushed me out here.
The grass under me withers in a heartbeat.
When I arrived, every bird fled.
From the End to here is a single step.
My hand lands first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声低吼，是我。
lines.en: That low growl you heard was mine.
Don't look up; it will weaken your knees.

lines.zh: 火贴上来，紫色皮肤发白。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my purple skin blanches.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我把地砸塌了。
lines.en: On landing I caved the ground in.

lines.zh: 水让我动弹不得，很难受。
lines.en: Water pins me in place; it is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推开，但没推开手。
lines.en: The blast threw me back, but not my hand.
There is a stick stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 药水让末影安静了一会儿。
lines.en: The potion quiets the ender for a moment.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，饿只是种感觉。
lines.en: I do not eat; hunger is only a feeling.

lines.zh: 雷光进了眼睛，好久没散。
lines.en: Lightning got in my eyes and stayed.

lines.zh: 虚空是我的门，不是深渊。
lines.en: The void is my door, not an abyss.
